title: the Kuiper Line Rising Revisited
author: Oscar Kavanagh
blurb: Wendell Marchetti, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
